name: Cosmic Kaleidoscope
source:
The story begins with a young man named Comet, who has a dream in which he is told to look for five stars, which when put together will create something magical and special.

In his adventure he will need companions, so he gathers a small group of companions, these being Apollo, Vesta, Andromeda and Venus, who will follow him on his journey.

[Translated from [url=https://capriciousmoral.itch.io/cosmic-kaleidoscope]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事从一位名叫彗星的年轻人开始。他在梦中得到指引，要去寻找五颗星星；将它们聚在一起，就能创造出某种神奇而特别的东西。

冒险需要同伴，于是，他集结了一支小队。阿波罗、维斯塔、安德洛墨达与维纳斯，将跟随他踏上旅程。

[译自 [url=https://capriciousmoral.itch.io/cosmic-kaleidoscope]Itch.io[/url]]
